cells.gaps: No regulation made under Loi n°007/PR/2015 and no decision, sanction or count under it has been found; ANSICE is named for transfers, but nothing found says it acts as a constituted data protection authority. The Digital Code and the April 2026 committee would replace the current texts and are drafting only.
cells.note: A July 2026 legal analysis treats Loi n°007/PR/2015 as the law in force on personal data, so the rung is 3. Stage 4 needs a dated decision under it.
